about.summary: Create quick and easy dot-and-whisker plots of regression results. It takes as input either (1) a coefficient table in standard form or (2) one (or a list of) fitted model objects (of any type that has methods implemented in the 'parameters' package). It returns 'ggplot' objects that can be further customized using tools from the 'ggplot2' package. The package also includes helper functions for tasks such as rescaling coefficients or relabeling predictor variables. See more methodological discussion of the visualization and data management methods used in this package in Kastellec and Leoni (2007) <doi:10.1017/S1537592707072209> and Gelman (2008) <doi:10.1002/sim.3107>.

name: r-dotwhisker
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.8.6" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-dotwhisker
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/dotwhisker_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/dotwhisker/dotwhisker_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: fde3e9d34af0b34f76ebfa2002e02e7114b18798aa617e9e96b8a4842938092a

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-dplyr
    - r-ggplot2 >=2.2.1
    - r-gridextra
    - r-gtable
    - r-marginaleffects
    - r-parameters
    - r-patchwork
    - r-performance
    - r-purrr
    - r-rlang
    - r-stringr
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-dplyr
    - r-ggplot2 >=2.2.1
    - r-gridextra
    - r-gtable
    - r-marginaleffects
    - r-parameters
    - r-patchwork
    - r-performance
    - r-purrr
    - r-rlang
    - r-stringr

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('dotwhisker')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('dotwhisker')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://fsolt.org/dotwhisker/
  license: MIT
  summary: Create quick and easy dot-and-whisker plots of regression results. It takes as input
    either (1) a coefficient table in standard form or (2) one (or a list of) fitted
    model objects (of any type that has methods implemented in the 'parameters' package).
    It returns 'ggplot' objects that can be further customized using tools from the
    'ggplot2' package. The package also includes helper functions for tasks such as
    rescaling coefficients or relabeling predictor variables. See more methodological
    discussion of the visualization and data management methods used in this package
    in Kastellec and Leoni (2007) <doi:10.1017/S1537592707072209> and Gelman (2008)
    <doi:10.1002/sim.3107>.
  license_family: MIT
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/MIT
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
